series.name: Cassette / 360° cassette LED colour-blink patterns
series.notes: Samsung cassette colour-blink guides (manual-derived third-party: Snowflake Aircon, Ample Air). Medium confidence. LED colour sequences, not numeric codes.

title.en: Red LED — indoor temperature sensor fault
title.ur: Lal LED — indoor temperature sensor kharab

meaning.en: The cassette indoor temperature sensor circuit has failed; unit stops or limits operation.
meaning.ur: Cassette ke indoor temperature sensor ka circuit kharab ho gaya hai; unit ruk jata hai ya mehdood chalta hai.

causes.en: Indoor TH sensor open/short or connector loose
causes.ur: Indoor TH sensor khula/short ya connector dhila

causes.en: Harness damage in the ceiling plenum
causes.ur: Ceiling ke plenum mein harness ki kharabi

solutions.en: Power cycle once; technician checks sensor resistance
solutions.ur: Ek baar power cycle karein; technician sensor ki resistance check kare
Sensor tabdeel karein ya harness ki marammat karein

source.title: Snowflake Aircon — Samsung aircon blinking light (red)

notes.en: Cassette colour LEDs replace alphanumeric codes on 4-way cassettes.
notes.ur: 4-way cassettes par alphanumeric codes ki jagah colour LED lagte hain.

title.en: Yellow-green + blue LED — float switch second detection
title.ur: Peela-hara + neela LED — float switch ki dobara detection

meaning.en: The drain/float safety switch has triggered a second time, indicating condensate overflow risk.
meaning.ur: Drain/float safety switch dobara trigger hua hai, jo condensate overflow ka khatra banta hai.

causes.en: Blocked drain pan/pump not lifting water
causes.ur: Drain pan ya pump band ho gaya hai, paani upar nahi uth raha

causes.en: Float switch stuck or overfilled pan
causes.ur: Float switch phans gaya hai ya pan mein zyada paani ho gaya

solutions.en: Clear drain line/pan and switch off until dry
solutions.ur: Drain line/pan saaf kare aur unit sukha ho jaane tak band rakhein

solutions.en: Technician tests drain pump and float switch
solutions.ur: Technician drain pump aur float switch test kare

source.title: Snowflake Aircon — Samsung aircon blinking light (float)

notes.en: Maps to service E153-type float second-detection family.
notes.ur: Yeh service E153-type float second-detection family se milta hai.

title.en: Blue + red LED — indoor fan error
title.ur: Neela + lal LED — indoor fan kharab

meaning.en: The cassette indoor fan/tacho feedback failed; airflow stopped.
meaning.ur: Cassette indoor ke fan/tacho ka feedback kharab hua, is liye airflow ruk gaya.

causes.en: Indoor fan motor jammed or failed
causes.ur: Indoor fan motor phans gaya hai ya kharab

solutions.en: Power off, clear the blower and restore power
solutions.ur: Power band karein, fan wheel saaf karke power wapas laayein

solutions.en: Technician tests fan motor and feedback
solutions.ur: Technician fan motor aur feedback test kare

source.title: Snowflake Aircon — Samsung aircon blinking light (fan)

notes.en: Related to E140/C140 indoor fan family.
notes.ur: Yeh E140/C140 indoor fan family se taluq rakhta hai.

title.en: Ice-blue LED (2 s) — power restored / status
title.ur: Ice-blue LED (2 s) — power on ho gaya / status

meaning.en: After power restoration the ice-blue LED blinks briefly as a status indication, not a fault.
meaning.ur: Power wapas aane ke baad ice-blue LED sirf status ke taur par halki chalti hai, kharabi nahi.

causes.ur: Bijli chali jane ke baad normal power-on ki indication

causes.en: User observing status, not a failure
causes.ur: User sirf status dekh raha hai, koi kharabi nahi

solutions.en: No action needed; wait for normal operation
solutions.ur: Koi zaroori kaam nahi; normal operation ka intezaar karein

solutions.en: If paired with an error LED, follow that error pattern
solutions.ur: Agar kisi error LED ke sath ho to us error pattern ko follow karein

source.title: Snowflake Aircon — Samsung aircon blinking light (ice-blue)

notes.en: Status only; not counted as a fault code by Samsung docs.
notes.ur: Sirf status hai; Samsung docs ise fault code nahi ginte.

title.en: Ice-blue LED (10 s) — defrost in progress
title.ur: Ice-blue LED (10 second) — defrost chal raha hai

meaning.en: The unit is in the heating defrost cycle; the ice-blue LED indicates this normal phase.
meaning.ur: Unit heating defrost cycle mein hai; ice-blue LED yeh aam phase dikhata hai.

causes.en: Extended defrost if outdoor coil is iced
causes.ur: Outdoor coil par barf ho to defrost lamba ho jata hai

solutions.ur: Intezaar karein; defrost ke baad heating dobara shuru hoti hai

solutions.en: If it never ends, technician checks sensors/drain
solutions.ur: Agar khatam na ho to technician sensors aur drain check kare

source.title: Snowflake Aircon — Samsung aircon blinking light (defrost)

notes.ur: Sirf status hai; is_fault flag set nahi hai, yaani koi fault nahi.
